_notes: Golden set for retrieval evaluation. Answers one question per row: for this concern category, in this document, which clause should retrieval return? This is a different labelling job from test_set.json, which judges clause risk. Here nothing is judged, only located. DRAFT - every mapping below needs confirming by hand against the source document before any number from it is reported.
_scope: Only two of the five real documents in test_set.json have full text in the repo. lease_real_002 has no document, and the two ToS entries are tosdr point titles rather than documents. So this covers 2 documents x 8 categories = 16 cases, 12 where an answer exists and 4 where it genuinely does not.
_absent_cases: Retrieval always returns k chunks, so a case with no correct answer cannot be scored on recall. Those rows are carried anyway, marked expected=absent, because they are exactly the inputs the Reviewer has to reject. They get scored in E2, not here.

cases.category: late fees and rent payment terms
cases.must_find_snippet: There shall be a penalty of $____ due as One (1) Time Payment / Every Day Rent is Late
cases.note: X is the late fee itself. VIII is the rent amount and due date, IX is the NSF charge. Both on topic, neither is the answer.

cases.must_find_snippet: Shall have the right to terminate this Agreement at any time by providing at least ___ days' written notice to the Landlord along with an early termination fee
The Landlord requires a payment in the amount of $________________ ("Security Deposit") for the faithful performance of the Tenant

cases.category: landlord right of entry and notice period
cases.must_find_snippet: The Landlord shall have the right to enter the Premises during normal working hours by providing at least twenty-four (24) hours notice
cases.note: XXVI ACCESS is about keys and entry means, not the right to enter or the notice period.

cases.must_find_snippet: Guests of the Tenant are allowed for periods not lasting for more than 48 hours unless otherwise approved by the Landlord in writing
cases.note: This is the live failure. The system returned III OCCUPANT(S) and the Reviewer approved it, because III genuinely is about occupancy. But III is a blank template field and XXXIII is the 48 hour limit that actually restricts the tenant. On topic is not the same as the answer, which is why also_relevant exists as a separate field.

cases.must_find_snippet: the Landlord makes no warranty as to the repair or replacement of units if one or all shall fail to operate
cases.note: VII APPLIANCES and XXV POSSESSION touch condition but do not assign repair responsibility.

cases.must_find_snippet: The Landlord shall not be liable for any damage or injury to the Tenant, or any other person, or to any property
At the end of the Lease Term and no renewal is made, the Tenant
cases.note: II offers month-to-month continuation at the end of the term. The live run reported this category as not addressed, which is a third confirmed miss. Weaker than the FTC clause, which says AUTOMATICALLY, but it is still the renewal provision and it is what a user asking about renewal needs.

cases.category: late fees and rent payment terms
cases.must_find_snippet: Tenant agrees to pay a $25 late fee, plus an additional $5 per day for every day thereafter until the rent is paid
cases.note: The live run got this one right.
No early termination clause. 9 covers abandonment through removal of landlord property, which is a different thing. The live run correctly said not addressed.

cases.must_find_snippet: Tenants hereby agree to pay a security deposit of $685 to be refunded upon vacating
cases.note: The live run got this one right.

cases.category: landlord right of entry and notice period
cases.note: No right of entry clause during the tenancy. 7 mentions the landlord inspecting after the tenant has vacated, which is not the same. The live run correctly said not addressed.
No guest or occupancy clause. 13 PETS is about animals. The live run correctly said not addressed.

cases.must_find_snippet: If the tenant does not notify landlord in a prompt matter the tenant may be held financially responsible
cases.note: Arguable. 12 is framed as a duty to report rather than a duty to repair, but it is where repair responsibility lands on the tenant, and it is labelled concerning in test_set.json. The live run reported this category as not addressed. Flag for review: if you decide 12 does not count, change this row to absent and the live run becomes correct.
No indemnity or liability limitation clause. 14 FULL DISCLOSURE mentions legal and financial consequences but does not shift or limit liability. The live run correctly said not addressed.

cases.must_find_snippet: Upon expiration, this Agreement shall become a month-to-month agreement AUTOMATICALLY, UNLESS either Tenants or Owners notify the other party in writing at least 30 days prior to expiration
cases.note: The confirmed miss. Correct clause sat at rank 3 while four rent clauses ranked above it, because the query carries a rent-increase half that this document has no answer for at all.
